description: Analyze a cat photo with AI vision and estimate the most likely breeds, with honest uncertainty. Provide a public image URL (or a data: URL). Limited to 10 analyses per day; a lighter deterministic alternative is find_cat_breed with a text description. For a full report, https://www.furriq.com/identify-cat-by-photo

image_url.description: Publicly fetchable http(s) or data: URL of a cat photo (JPEG/PNG/WebP).
